mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: current conditions at Verona Community Park show 60 degrees under clear skies, with a New Moon phase visible tonight.

In city news, the Verona Common Council has unanimously adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan, a key framework to guide our city's long-term development. Additionally, the city is continuing its commitment to infrastructure, with engineering reports regularly updated for council review.
We have a busy couple of days ahead. Today, you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run or the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out yoga at Insight Wellness to get centered.

Looking at the weekly police report, an incident occurred on October 3 where a 19-year-old was arrested for being a felon in possession of a firearm following a traffic stop where a stolen weapon was recovered.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Caramel Cashew. The store is currently closed, but it will open today at 10:00 AM for you to enjoy your treat.
